notes.title: THE 8IGHT ver.25.1.7 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello,

Below are the patch notes for THE 8IGHT ver.25.1.7.

[Patch Notes]

1. Improvements
● For a more immersive experience, the in-game Crosshair has been removed.
● A message about “Save” has been added to the loading screen when entering the game.
  "THE 8IGHT includes up to Chapter 3, and a single save occurs at a specific location in each chapter."
● A hint clue for a certain object has been added.
● The difficulty of the Chapter 2 event (the illuminated room) has been slightly reduced. (Lights are turned off where you’ve passed)
● Visibility of text inside a certain locker has been increased.
● The main character’s dialogue is now center-aligned.
● The positions of the “Load Save,” “Delete,” and “Initialize” buttons for save files have been changed.
● The UI for the Load Save tab has been partially improved.

2. Issue Fixes
● Fixed an issue where movement was sometimes impossible even after an event cutscene ended.
● Fixed an issue where the outline of certain objects was not being properly recognized.
● Fixed an issue where some walls were split apart.
● Fixed an issue where objects inside a drawer could be seen without opening the drawer.
● Modified so that you cannot press the ESC key while holding a lock.

For a smoother gameplay experience, we recommend updating the game before playing.

※ If you have any other issues or feedback regarding the game, please contact us at the following email. We will do our best to check and respond promptly.

notes.title: THE 8IGHT ver.25.1.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello, 

Here are the patch notes for THE 8IGHT ver.25.1.4:

[Patch Notes]
1. Fix for Duplicate Save Issue
Fixed an issue where chapters that had already been saved were being saved again unnecessarily.

2. Save Location Adjustments
The save locations for Chapter 1 and Chapter 3 have been adjusted as follows:
● Chapter 1: From the start of Chapter 1 → After some progress in Chapter 1
● Chapter 3: From the start of Chapter 3 → To the Chapter 3 ending branch point
※ With this adjustment, we hope you can more easily explore multiple endings through the ending branch save point.
※ Please note that this adjustment will not apply to already saved locations. We recommend deleting your save files and applying the update again.

3. Improvements
● Adjusted the hint message displayed when obtaining the final clue.
● Fixed an issue where unnecessary movement was required after save loads.
● Fixed an issue where outlines of certain objects were activated after save loads.
● Fixed an issue where some items could be acquired again after save loads.
● Adjusted the position of the save delete/reset buttons to prevent accidental deletions.

For a smoother gameplay experience, we recommend [updating] before proceeding.

※ If you encounter any issues or have suggestions about the game, please send them to the email below. We will review them as quickly as possible.
Contact Email ▶ kjaegames@gmail.com

Thank you,
KJAE GAMES

At 11 AM on January 24(UTC), 'THE 8IGHT' has been officially released!
To celebrate the official release, we're offering a special discount! Get 'THE 8IGHT' at 30% off!

The truth behind recurring nightmares, the cause of schizophrenia, and the hidden story within.

And first, find the medicine that can alleviate the symptoms.

Perhaps that medicine could solve everything. Or could it?
